summary: Build crisis response plans, holding statements, and stakeholder control skills in this advanced 5-day course.
lede: Crisis management and crisis communication help teams assess disruptions and coordinate decisions, response actions, and stakeholder messages. For professionals who lead or support high-stakes responses, the course develops skills in setting severity, structuring response teams, drafting holding statements, mapping stakeholder messages, managing media and social channels, and documenting decisions and recovery actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead or support high-stakes response, message control, and stakeholder coordination when disruption affects operations, reputation, or trust.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of corporate communications, risk management, or business continuity processes; familiarity with incident escalation or issue management workflows; and comfort drafting internal and external messages under time pressure. No coding is required. Prior exposure to crisis plans, media handling, or resilience exercises will help you move faster, but the course is structured so advanced practitioners can apply it to their own operating model immediately.
